name: production-dashboard-ui-ux-skill

Use Production Dashboard UI/UX Skill to redesign this dashboard as a production-ready product interface.
Use Production Dashboard UI/UX Skill to review and improve the current palette, typography, logo treatment, responsive behavior, and design-system consistency.
